gse244832.allowed_use: External-development terminal-query robustness only after a training-only bridge topology is frozen. Different aliquots remain distinct datasets and cells.
gse244832.model_access: No query labels, ATAC targets, scaling, reference PCA/LDA, bridge fitting, feature ranking, k selection, prototypes, or calibration may affect the scored mapping.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only terminal-query cell-state mapping after selection lock.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA matrix only; it remains a terminal leaf and cannot alter training topology, reference coordinates, transformations, head, neighbours, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training reference and same-nucleus bridge construction, plus donor-held terminal-query development evaluation after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors construct stacked RNA-ATAC bridges, gene-activity bridges, feature lists, PCA/LDA, projections, centering origin, labels/head, or neighbour structures.

local_model_roster.common_lane: training-only PC reference scores and identical common head; labels_list is NULL
local_model_roster.native_lane: training-label LDA or classifyEmbedding only as a separately declared native result

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; distinct query/reference datasets, never stacked as one cell
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; a stacked bridge is permitted only after exact row join validation and uses unique namespaced feature rows

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nearest neighbours, feature overlaps, and topology paths are not replicates.
rules.query_isolation: A held or sealed dataset is a terminal topology leaf and cannot serve as a reference or bridge for another dataset.
rules.transform_contract: Use frozen upstream assay-native transformations, scale.center=false, scale.scale=false, projectAll=false, and training-reference-only centering.
rules.unique_cells: Every assay_list cell name is globally unique. Same-nucleus paired assays use one validated stacked bridge matrix.
